mechanism.statement: An affine FFN base plus native whole-group coefficient residual is a stronger local representation than exact matched projection group pruning. Its benefit need not imply narrow linear hot ranges: GELU has an exact odd half-linear part and an even remainder whose W2 contributions can cancel.
mechanism.math_or_trace: For real tanh-GELU, phi(a)=a/2+e(a), e(-a)=e(a). OLS slope=1/2+Cov(a,e(a))/Var(a); symmetric a gives1/2 without small curvature. For actual q2_post, q=kappa*a+beta+r is an exact coefficient decomposition, and W2 q=A x+B+W2 r in continuous arithmetic. Native Q2/BF16 and the folded finite implementation do not inherit bitwise equality.
